rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for someone kindly disposed or acting for others' good.

example.english: They are really benevolent; whenever they see elderly people, they help out.
example.traditional: 佢真係好心，見到老人家就幫手。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sam1 gin3 dou3 lou5 jan4 gaa1 zau6 bong1 sau2

rows.note: Use this in a more serious description of a person, ruler, or institution as kind and merciful, rather than the everyday 好心.

example.english: That king was known as benevolent.
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 gwok3 wong4 ji5 jan4 ci4 gin3 cing1

rows.note: Use this when benevolence specifically means caring about people and acting altruistically, rather than simply being kind.

example.english: This organization is very benevolent and always takes care of stray animals.
example.traditional: 呢間機構好有愛心，成日照顧流浪動物。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gei1 kau3 hou2 jau5 oi3 sam1 seng4 jat6 ziu3 gu3 lau4 long4 dung6 mat6
